summary.en-US: Call blocker for HONG KONG only. Block spam and scams w/o annoying ads!
summary.zh-HK: 香港出品 來電攔截App使用hkjunkcall 資料庫不要求無需要權限絕不彈出滋擾廣告畫面辨識及攔截 推銷/詐騙電話按Caller ID辨識機構來電

description.en-US: ► ☆Made in Hong Kong☆ ► ☆Never spams you for promotion or rating☆ ► ☆No ads and other tracking and analytics software☆, saves data and protects privacy ► Display of information on callers for blocked calls, including a summary of recent calls from the caller, industry / serious level for spam calls, to aid decision on whether to pick up the call ► Block foreign '+' prefixed invalid IDD calls, ☆normal IDD not affected☆ ► Automatic update of HKJunkCall database, allow setting of update time / restrict update to Wifi only. No restrictions on manual updates. ► Support Android 4.1 and above ► Fullest choice of spam call blocking actions, including ☆pick up and hang up☆ (prevent call forwarding / activating mailbox), which is applicable up to Android 5.0 and above, and root options ► Custom block and allow list (import from vCard and old app), and specify allowed junk call numbers / names, e.g. specify that spam caller with a certain name should not be blocked ► Report spam calls to update the database of HKJunkCall.com, auto report of blocked calls ► Auto inclusion of reported calls to temp junk list and starts blocking immediately ► Auto prompt for reporting spam calls after conversation with near-junk numbers (or unknown numbers as set by user) ► Organization list to alert on the Caller ID of Government / public / commercial organizations ► Outgoing call protection to defend against Wangiri (one-ring) scam ► ☆Support dual-SIM☆ in call blocking / records（Experimental） ► Small memory footprint. Unused memory is quickly released when user quits the app. For users of Android 5 or above: Due to the design of Android 5.0 and above, users need to grant the permissions to Headuck Call blocker manually after installation, as follows- For Android 5.0 or above: Under App Settings ＞ Filtering actions > Set Notification access, please grant notification access to the app for the normal function of "Pick and hang up" filtering method, and for stopping vibration during filtering. For Android 6.0 or above: Under App Settings > Filtering actions > Draw over other apps, please grant permission to HeaDuck for the App to display pop-up window during call correctly. IMPORTANT: Please note - In some models, you need to manually grant this App auto-start and phone tapping permissions, before it can function normally. If you use task killers (whether as part of the system, such as Samsung or most Mainland phone models, or another App such as CleaX MXster), this App should be exempted from "optimization" for its proper functioning. Huawei phones will probably not work due to aggressive killing of background jobs. After installing the App, please start and enable blocking for proper functioning.
description.zh-HK: 「小鴨幹線」為香港出品，受香港私隱法例管轄，☆絕不強制用戶提供個人資料登記☆，良心保證： ► 保障私隱為先，只須基本攔截權限（電話及來電紀錄）便可運作，絕不強制要求不必要的權限，☆絕不強制設為預設通話程式☆ ► 沒有「反查」私人電話功能，因此☆絕不會☆亦沒有需要收集用戶個人資料及通訊錄資料， ► 沒有廣告，☆絕不包含☆會收集不相關（如用戶習慣及位置）資料作巿場推廣或出售等用途的廣告及追蹤商程式，節省數據流量及記憶，減低私隱風險 ► ☆絕無☆借故加插滋擾性的鎖屏畫面或彈出廣告視窗等以獲取廣告收入，☆真正隔絕滋擾☆ 通訊錄私隱問題詳見：http://blog.headuck.com/?p=505 與 其他攔截／反查程式 權限比較：http://blog.headuck.com/?p=518 有關 Android 8 或以上的「攔截動作開啟」通知，見 http://blog.headuck.com/?p=706 ★☆★［重要］此程式在華為手機很可能無效，在三星，華為以外的大陸ROM，HTC，華碩等，要特別設定才生效，請先參閱 http://blog.headuck.com/?p=449★☆★ 要點及功能 ► ☆沒有廣告及其他追踪用戶習慣、判別用戶身分之類的外來軟件☆， ► 針對境外「+」號開頭的詐騙來電，☆獨有辨識及封鎖無效IDD號碼功能，不攔截正常IDD☆，並顯示正常IDD來電屬地。未加入資料庫的假號碼亦可識別及攔截。 ► 彈出視窗即時顯示被封鎖來電的資訊，包括 ☆近期攔截摘要☆，騷擾及惡意來電的☆行業及嚴重程度☆，亦可設定顯示來電SIM。在設定「沒有動作」攔截方式下，方便決定是否接電話 ► 自動更新HKJunkcall資料庫，可指定時間及指定僅限Wi-Fi更新，手動更新沒有限制 ► 封鎖騷擾及惡意來電方式，提供多項進階選擇，包括☆接通再掛線☆（防止轉駁/留言），漫游設定及root選項（包括通話中攔截，只適用於部份機種） ► 自訂我的黑名單及白名單（可自行匯入匯出至vcf格式），以及不作攔截的例外廣告電話／名稱名單，例如指定不攔截某機構。 ► ☆回報廣告及騷擾 / 詐騙電話☆，以持續更新HKJunkcall資料庫，可選擇自動回報已封鎖廣告電話。手動回報電話自動加入臨時名單，即時開始攔截。 ► 接聽近似廣告號碼（或可設定所有不在名單號碼）後，自動提示回報，當中近似高頻推銷（如XX Beauty）號碼字頭可以攔截（注：近似攔截存有風險）。 ► 機構名單，按 Caller ID 辨識及提示來電的政府，公共機構和商業機構 ► 撥出防護，阻截「一響收線」騙案 ► 攔截及來電記錄☆支援雙卡☆（試驗中） ► 唔大食，退出程式後快速釋放記憶，背景運作僅使用少量RAM 詳細功能及使用／權限說明：http://blog.headuck.com/?p=148 常見問題：http://blog.headuck.com/?p=406
